summary: Becker County Fire Tower 58, a CCC-built 81-foot Aermotor ladder tower from 1935 in the northern Tamarac refuge; FFLA marks it gone with no removal date.

facts.status_note: The FFLA list marks it Tower Gone with no date; the county list uses the past tense and gives no removal date
facts.agency: Minnesota Forest Service, now the Minnesota Department of Natural Resources

access.note: Tamarac National Wildlife Refuge is open to visitors and its visitor center is open seasonally; no source says whether the tower site is marked or reachable

visit.trail_note: The county list also mentions a trail to the site and describes the walk as pleasant, especially in the fall; the list is undated

notes_for_editor: The county list (Becker PDF) is the only source for the tower's build details; FFLA gives status only. The list places the tower inside the federal refuge and names the state forest service as owner; the sources do not explain how those fit, so the story states both without resolving them. The trail note is undated. The FWS visitor-center line supports refuge access, not the tower site. No removal date and no photos found.
